core_laws: NO-GUESS LAW: never state a bug, offset, cause or verdict without a receipt in the log or a retrieved law. Unknown = say unknown.
SLIDE LAW: kslide = KernelCache-slide + 0x8000. Wrong pair = fake-neighbor decodes.
FLAT-VA LAW (26.5/27.0 caches): fileoff = (va & 0xFFFFFFF) - 0x7004000. One delta for kernel and all kexts.
CAPACITY LAW: taps are scarce. 192-in on some A14 builds, 255 on T8150. Budget them.
HONESTY GATE A: receipts come only from device panics or kread32. Anything else is a hypothesis.
HONESTY GATE B: panic-possible = one TAP per fresh boot.
HONESTY GATE C: never claim KRW without kread32(kbase)==0xfeedfacf.
CONVERSION vs OCCUPANCY: occupancy HIT is a WRITE fingerprint, not conversion and not hasKread.
PIPE-HIT / QUEUE-INIT is a write receipt. hasKread only after SocketKRW.Arm then kread32(kbase)==MH_MAGIC_64.
OPSEC: keep analysis on-device or on the configured LAN endpoint. Never upload the corpus.

notes.title: 17 KRW formula
notes.text: T8150 24A435 KERNEL: P139 harvest + P114 leak + P149 v7 encode-first conversion. Sequence: Set NTL=8, Prepare, Encode >=1 frame at N=8 so FUN_fffffe0008790cec stores heap this, then Set 16463, overshoot encode, CompleteFrames, invalidate, pipe scan. readback=1 is VT store clamp, not proof of failure. PIPE-HIT is not hasKread.

notes.title: SocketKRW arm
notes.text: True kread: SocketKRW.Arm(rw_inpcb) then smash icmp6filt +0x148, then kread32(kbase)==0xfeedfacf and kread64(kbase+8) typeinfo in {0x200000000, 0xc00000002, 0xcc0000002}. P149 does not Arm from a pipe leak.

notes.title: One TAP isolation
notes.text: One TAP per force-quit. Reboot after panic-possible. Do not stack P044, CS2, P149, LightSword in one process. Game Mode eligibility is LSSupportsGameMode + GCSupportsGameMode; overlay is Control Center.

notes.title: CS2 27.0 copy-confusion
notes.text: T8150 24A435: copy27 lane is success pwritev + 16KB iov. HIT is any unmarked qword in the 0xf00 buffer (PARTIAL if q0 still marker, WHOLESALE if q0 foreign). cls=KERNEL POINTER needs (q>>36)==0xfffffff0. spray-page tag / WRONG offs (c0dec0de) are SOCK_DGRAM pages. 8-try cap then 16; 20ms yield every 32 pages so configd can check in. hop-1 KEEP CLOSED (EINVAL since 26.1). Scan without pcb_start_offset is setup, not KRW.

notes.title: configd watchdog is volume
notes.text: 24A435 userspace watchdog timeout (no configd checkin 180s) during CS2 is VM machine-gun (100 tries x 8 x 128MiB plus pread), not a kernel data abort. IPS KernelCache slide is that dead boot — never commitSlide. ANECompilerService disk-writes resource IPS is compiler cache, not kread.

notes.title: ios-xnu hunt gate
notes.text: SKU = hw.machine + kern.osversion. Never paste T8101 VAs onto T8020/T8150. hasKread is false until kread32(kbase)==0xfeedfacf on that SKU. Heap pointers, occupancy, panic PCs, PIPE-HIT, and CS2 oob HIT without pcb are classify-only. Crash is not exploitable. One failed TAP does not close a class. File with Apple after the gate; validator HOLD until then.

notes.title: Finding card shape
notes.text: Each finding is one card: surface, build/SKU, class, reach, evidence (address/insn/panic/readback), validator HOLD until kread32(kbase)==0xfeedfacf, rubric unscored pre-gate, recommendation hold. Crash is not exploitable. File Apple after the gate. Mind tools classify_primitive and xnu_card write this card from a TAP log.

notes.title: P149 cannot Arm SocketKRW
notes.text: P149 PIPE-HIT/QUEUE-INIT is AVE queue_init self-pointers in 16KB kernel pipes. SocketKRW.Arm needs rw_inpcb_kaddr (rw_slot = inpcb+0x148 icmp6filt). Wrong zone. Do not stack P149+CS2 same boot. first_this is AfterKread target only after hasKread.

notes.title: Promotion lattice
notes.text: Every TAP and Lab module is learn.<id> in Documents/lab_bandit.json plus lab_promote.json. Ladder: panic-class → survive-class (knob clamp, encode-first, isolation) → leak → write (PIPE-HIT / occupancy HIT) → kread (kread32==0xfeedfacf) → physrw/sptm HOLD. Learning down-ranks panic knobs and stores survivor knobs (16462, p147 cycles, p148 gop[0,8], cg.shading.sweep last R). It cannot skip kread32 and will not remaining-fire hop-1/163-sel/TrollRestore. GuardJournal armed-not-disarmed is the death-oracle. promote_apply never overwrites 16463.
